newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil telecom rates to rise up to 200 pct - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil telecom rates to rise up to 200 pct - report.

text.p: Brazil's state-run telecommunications firm Telebras will raise call rates by as much as 200 percent at an as yet undetermined date, national Globo television reported Wednesday.
Globo said local and interurban rates will rise while international call rates will fall.
No one could be reached at the company for comment.
The television station said Telebras President Fernando Xavier did not say when the price changes might take effect. It was not clear where Xavier was speaking.
Globo said the tariff changes were part of Telebras' preparation for eventual privatization.
It was not clear where Xavier was speaking.

Several months ago, newspapers reported that telephone rates could rise by 200 percent in October or November because there had not been any price rises for a year. The reports were denied at the time. -- Michael Christie, Brasilia newsroom 55-61-2230358
